title: Sordland/Turn01/InT_Infrastructure
description: Gus Manger and Lileas Graf seem to be in a heated argument. Two different infrastructure projects to kick start the economic recovery plans are presented. Gus Manger has ties to construction firms in Holsord and Gelsland and Lileas Graf is friends with the mayor of Arvory Eric Niel. Symon Holl specifically wants to focus on infrastructure projects first because they tend to show quick and visible results. He hopes that these will prove his efficiency in providing an economic recovery.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Mr. President, we need to focus on..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, we need to focus on boosting the economy as quickly as possible. One of the fastest ways to achieve this is through infrastructure projects.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“On the one hand, businessmen are c..."
entries.dialogueText: “On the one hand, businessmen are complaining about the slow logistical rail network between Holsord and Lachaven.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“On the other hand, citizens are cr..."
entries.dialogueText: “On the other hand, citizens are criticizing the lack of a proper highway connection between Lachaven and Arvory. The narrow roads by the seaside are not only dangerous but also difficult to traverse.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What can we focus on?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What can we focus on?”
entries.menuText: “What can we focus on?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“To that point, I defined two impor..."
entries.dialogueText: “To that point, I defined two important projects for your attention. The H-3 Highway project and the L-1 High-speed railway project.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The H-3 highway project.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The H-3 highway project.”
entries.menuText: “The H-3 highway project.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The H-3 project aims to improve th..."
entries.dialogueText: “The H-3 project aims to improve the abysmal state of the road network in the Agnland region bordering Agnolia. The area is home to several million Agno-Sordish and Sordish citizens, who currently feel neglected.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Your predecessor Alphonso failed t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your predecessor Alphonso failed to deliver on this campaign promise. But now, we have the opportunity to start the construction of a groundbreaking railway project.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The L-1 high-speed rail project.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The L-1 high-speed rail project.”
entries.menuText: “The L-1 high-speed rail project.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“There are no proper highway connec..."
entries.dialogueText: “There are no proper highway connections to and from Agnland. The mayor of Arvory, Eric Niel, has been asking for a bigger budget to develop the regional infrastructure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't leave the request of Eric..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't leave the request of Eric Niel -- a party member -- unanswered."
entries.menuText: "We can't leave the request of Eric Niel -- a party member -- unanswered."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree. This could also hurt the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. This could also hurt the local businesses.”
entries.menuText: “I agree. This could also hurt the local businesses.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Agreed. The superpowers have led t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. The superpowers have led the way with their high-quality technology. We've got to keep up.”
entries.menuText: “Agreed. The superpowers have led the way with their high-quality technology. We've got to keep up.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This could also empower businesses..."
entries.dialogueText: “This could also empower businesses and bring investments.”
entries.menuText: “This could also empower businesses and bring investments.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“As you know, our current trains ca..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you know, our current trains cannot meet the standards of today. As many other countries adopt new electric engine technology to power up their trains, we're falling behind.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That must be cumbersome for the ci..."
entries.dialogueText: “That must be cumbersome for the citizens."
entries.menuText: “That must be cumbersome for the citizens."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The major cities of Sordland need..."
entries.dialogueText: “The major cities of Sordland need more infrastructure to support their growing populations.”
entries.menuText: “The major cities of Sordland need more infrastructure to support their growing populations.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Let's take a more detailed look at..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's take a more detailed look at the upgrade proposal.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Lileas was pointing at Lachaven."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas was pointing at Lachaven.
entries.menuText: Look at the map.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have decided on the H-3 highway..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have decided on the H-3 highway project to improve the infrastructure in our poorer regions.”
entries.menuText: “I have decided on the H-3 highway project to improve the infrastructure in our poorer regions.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have decided on the L-1 high-spe..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have decided on the L-1 high-speed rail project to improve the connection between our most productive cities.”
entries.menuText: “I have decided on the L-1 high-speed rail project to improve the connection between our most productive cities.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“News about the new electric trains..."
entries.dialogueText: “News about the new electric trains in United Contana has piqued our businesses' interest. They too want to transport resources and material from Holsord to Lachaven with great speed and efficiency.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“He told us that even trucks are ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “He told us that even trucks are having a hard time travelling through the main roads. The increased traffic is causing trouble for people commuting in and out of the region.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“From there, it will go to Anrica f..."
entries.dialogueText: “From there, it will go to Anrica first...”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Our plan is to upgrade the old L-1..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our plan is to upgrade the old L-1 line from Holsord to Lachaven. It will transform into a high-speed railway.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Gus was pointing at Holsord while S..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus was pointing at Holsord while Symon was looking attentively.
entries.menuText: Look at the map.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The Ministry estimates that constr..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Ministry estimates that construction will be completed in two years if every step going forward is executed successfully.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you all for your contributio..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you all for your contributions and thoughts. Have a good day.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you all for your contributions and thoughts.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. Is there anything else?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Is there anything else?”
entries.menuText: “Good. Is there anything else?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The negotiations will begin in the..."
entries.dialogueText: “The negotiations will begin in the middle of this year. You will be able to award the contract to a corporation of your choice.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“So, which one do you want to hear..."
entries.dialogueText: “So, which one do you want to hear about first?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mr. Holl repositioned himself on hi..."
entries.dialogueText: Mr. Holl repositioned himself on his chair.

entries.title: Player: "“We must prove our capabilities. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must prove our capabilities. The people must know that this administration can get things done.”
entries.menuText: “We must prove our capabilities. The people must know that this administration can get things done.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must improve the economy of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must improve the economy of the nation and bring it out of recession.”
entries.menuText: “We must improve the economy of the nation and bring it out of recession.”

entries.title: Player: "“It makes little sense to put inves..."
entries.dialogueText: “It makes little sense to put investments in such a remote region.”
entries.menuText: “It makes little sense to put investments in such a remote region.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“As mayor, I saw the central govern..."
entries.dialogueText: “As mayor, I saw the central government continuously neglect our country's Agno-Sordish-dominated regions. Is this administration going to continue that kind of negligence?”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We are talking about the wealthies..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are talking about the wealthiest regions and forgetting about Agnland, which needs the investment far more.”

entries.dialogueText: “For the wealthy and middle-class citizens of these regions, but not for the poor dears who wouldn't be able to afford the increased ticket prices.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I completely agree. Our attentions..."
entries.dialogueText: “I completely agree. Our attentions must be diverted to the needy. The H-3 is a much more logical plan.”

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Sure. But most goods flow to Lacha..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sure. But most goods flow to Lachaven and Holsord, which means we should give more importance to logistics there.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Yes, there should be no preference..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, there should be no preference or separation among Sordish citizens. Meaning we should think about what's best for the country overall.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That is why we should initiate the..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is why we should initiate the L-1 project.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evening settled on the beautiful co..."
entries.dialogueText: Evening settled on the beautiful coastline of Lachaven.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“The ministry can only support one..."
entries.dialogueText: “The ministry can only support one project at a time with our current capacity and budget. Let's move on to the details of each.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But enjoying the luxurious mansion..."
entries.dialogueText: But enjoying the luxurious mansion wasn't the main reason of our visit. We gathered the economic team here to discuss the new infrastructure investment project.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The view towards the Markian Sea fr..."
entries.dialogueText: The view towards the Markian Sea from Lachaven was nothing short of exquisite. The seaside state residence fittingly named the Blue Mansion was large, fine and accommodating.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Their demands are just. The dire s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Their demands are just. The dire situation of the road infrastructure between Lachaven and Arvory can't be neglected.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“But the return in investment will..."
entries.dialogueText: “But the return in investment will be low. Our concern should be economic growth.”

entries.title: Player: ""I'm not fully convinced yet. Pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not fully convinced yet. Please explain further."
entries.menuText: "I'm not fully convinced yet. Please explain further."

entries.dialogueText: “I know him personally and can vouch that he is a trustworthy member of our party.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“It is, bless their souls. I'm happ..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is, bless their souls. I'm happy we're thinking alike on the matter.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I'm not sure if this region should be a priority for us right now.”
entries.menuText: “I'm not sure if this region should be a priority for us right now.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Businessmen in the region will be..."
entries.dialogueText: “Businessmen in the region will be very content, which in turn will increase investments and employment. Therefore I will recommend the L-1 high-speed rail project.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Our citizens will be quite pleased..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our citizens will be quite pleased if we successfully accomplish this. Besides, if we enter trade talks with Agnolia, they will see the investment as a positive sign.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I have to disagree. it will increa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have to disagree. it will increase the speed of transportation throughout the region.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Only technological advancement wil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Only technological advancement will give us an edge in the international arena.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“This should be our priority, growt..."
entries.dialogueText: “This should be our priority, growth and development optimization.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Half an hour had already passed sin..."
entries.dialogueText: Half an hour had already passed since the start of the meeting. Unfortunately I did not even have the chance to have my usual afternoon coffee.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking at the view from the window..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking at the view from the windows, I let my mind drift for a couple of seconds. Symon's voice brought me back into the ongoing discussion.

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Excellent. What will your final ch..."
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent. What will your final choice be, Mr. President?”

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“...and then connect to Gelsord.”"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“After which it will reach Lachaven..."
entries.dialogueText: “After which it will reach Lachaven, our economic powerhouse.”

entries.dialogueText: “The L-1 will significantly boost the economies of the newly linked cities and even the rural areas in between. Lachaven is our primary port, so the goods unloaded there will be transported to Holsord much faster.”

entries.dialogueText: “...from there it goes all the way to Arvory.”
